text: Yoghurt or soured milk is drained or pressed into a firm curd, salted, shaped into balls or pieces and dried in sun and air. Kashk and jameed take a detour: the yoghurt is first churned and the sour buttermilk boiled to curdle it, as for buttermilk cheese.

steps.note: The curd is brought to 60–70 % solids.
The curd is shaped into balls of 30–40 g.
The balls are left out in the sun.

processing.text: Kashk and jameed are churned first and the buttermilk boiled.
